description: Read a county’s economic vitality dossier (Census 15-sector business patterns, establishments, employees, payroll, average annual wage, new SOS LLC/Corp formations, SEC Form D capital raises, Form 4/FEC major donors,…

fips.description: Optional 5-digit county FIPS code (e.g. "06087" for Santa Cruz County CA, "36061" for New York County NY) for a full county dossier.

limit.description: Maximum counties to return when ranking a state (default 50, max 200).

sort.description: Sort field when ranking counties in a state (default avg_annual_wage_usd).

state.description: Optional two-letter state code (e.g. "CA", "TX", "NY") to rank counties across a state.

workspace_scope.description: Optional workspace for THIS call: use an exact personal/team ID from list_workspaces. Repeat on each call; it does not change the connection default. Must agree with MCP metadata and the effective HTTP workspace selector (header, otherwise connector URL). OAuth connections can only use their granted workspace. Membership and campaign permissions still apply.

name: get_county_economic_and_wealth_profile
